name: Grow Your Speed ⚡
desc:
⚡ Welcome to Grow Your Speed ⚡

Are you ready to become the fastest? Click to gain speed, beat obstacle courses to earn even more speed per click, and collect wins! Unlock new worlds, hatch pets, and race with your friends!

[How To Play]
• Click to gain speed!
• Complete obbies to boost your click power!
• Collect wins and hatch powerful pets!
• Rebirth to gain even more speed!
• Unlock new worlds and keep progressing!

Remember, your speed keeps growing even while you're offline.⭐

Roblox Premium: +50% Speed & Daily Rewards!💎
Join our group for daily rewards & +10% Speed!🎁
Invite friends to gain extra speed!👥
